title: Lower a needle onto a record
description: Lower a tonearm onto a record you may play, and lift it without dragging across the grooves.
oneStarDescription: Set the speed the label asks, or say the player has one speed.
twoStarDescription: Lower it onto the lead-in or the start, not the label.
threeStarDescription: Lift it off without a long scrape.

title: Knot a friendship bracelet
description: Knot a short bracelet from embroidery floss so the knots make a repeating band.
oneStarDescription: Tie the threads off at one end.
twoStarDescription: Make a short band of the same knot.
threeStarDescription: Tie the end so it does not unravel when you tug.

title: Make a pinhole camera
description: Make a dark box with one pinhole and see an image on the tracing-paper screen.
oneStarDescription: Close a box so light enters only at the hole you will prick.
twoStarDescription: Prick one small hole. A second person can see that this step happened: prick the hole.
threeStarDescription: Point the hole at a bright window or a lamp and say what appears on the screen.

title: Mark a tide line from the shore
description: Mark the wet line on a shore you can reach safely, and later say whether it moved.
oneStarDescription: Put a stick or a note at the wet line, above the water.
twoStarDescription: Come back later. A second person can see that this step happened: leave it.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the water is above or below the mark.

title: Mark one pattern size
description: On a multi-size pattern, mark only the size you chose and say which line you will not cut.
oneStarDescription: Write the size. A second person can see that this step happened: choose the size.
twoStarDescription: Mark that size's line on one edge.
threeStarDescription: Point to a size line you will not cut.

title: Match a shell to its outline
description: Draw a shell's outline and fit the shell back into it.
oneStarDescription: Trace or draw the outline of one shell.
twoStarDescription: Put the shell back in the outline.
threeStarDescription: Use a second shell and say which outline is which.

title: Match a thread to a cloth
description: Choose the closer of two threads to a cloth, in the light you will sew in.
oneStarDescription: Hold both threads on the cloth.
twoStarDescription: Say which thread is closer.
threeStarDescription: Look again in another light and say if your choice held.

title: Measure a trunk with string
description: Put a string around a tree trunk at about chest height and mark the length.
oneStarDescription: Hold the string at about chest height.
twoStarDescription: Bring the string around until the ends meet.
threeStarDescription: Mark or measure the string and say it is the girth, not the age.

title: Tell a mosaic from a fresco in a photo
description: Say whether a picture is made of pieces or painted onto a surface, using a photo or a work you can see.
oneStarDescription: Point to the surface. A second person can see that this step happened: look close.
twoStarDescription: Say mosaic or painted surface, and the clue.
threeStarDescription: If you cannot see the surface, say the photo is not enough.

title: Name a door as single or double
description: Say whether a doorway has one leaf or two, and which leaf has the lock if you can see it.
oneStarDescription: Say one or two. A second person can see that this step happened: count the leaves.
twoStarDescription: Point to the lock, or say you cannot see it.
threeStarDescription: Say which leaf would open first if you used the lock you see.

title: Name a flower part from a chart
description: Point to a petal and one other part, using a chart, on a flower you may touch or a photo.
oneStarDescription: Point to a petal. A second person can see that this step happened: find a petal.
twoStarDescription: Point to a sepal, stamen, or the center and use the chart's word.
threeStarDescription: If a part is gone, say so instead of guessing.

title: Name a medium from a label
description: Read the medium on a gallery label, such as oil or watercolor, and do not guess if it is missing.
oneStarDescription: Point to the label for one work.
twoStarDescription: Read the medium, or say it is not printed.
threeStarDescription: Say you used the label, not a guess from shine.

title: Name a plug shape
description: Name the shape of a plug you can see, and do not wire it.
oneStarDescription: Point to the pins. A second person can see that this step happened: look at the pins.
twoStarDescription: Say how many pins and whether one is different.
threeStarDescription: Say you will not open or rewire it.

title: Name a star color you can see
description: Call one star white, blue-white, or reddish, and say if you cannot tell.
oneStarDescription: Point to a bright star, not a planet you already tracked.
twoStarDescription: Say the color you see, or say it looks plain white.
threeStarDescription: Compare it with another star and say which is warmer in color.

title: Name an instrument family
description: Hear one instrument and name its family, such as strings, winds, or percussion, not the piece.
oneStarDescription: Hear a short example. A second person can see that this step happened: listen.
twoStarDescription: Say the family and not a song title.
threeStarDescription: If you do not know the exact instrument, say the family only.

title: Name the moon phase you see
description: Match the moon you see to a phase name on a chart, and point to the lit side.
oneStarDescription: Point to the moon without looking at the sun.
twoStarDescription: Say the phase name that matches the shape.
threeStarDescription: Point to the lit side and say whether your name still fits.

title: Name three clouds from a chart
description: Match three clouds you can see to names on a cloud chart.
oneStarDescription: Name one cloud with the chart in hand.
twoStarDescription: Name three different clouds, or say the sky has only one kind.
threeStarDescription: Look again later and say whether one name still fits.

title: Tell a needle leaf from a broad leaf
description: Sort leaves or photos into needles and broad leaves.
oneStarDescription: Place one of each, or say you have only one kind.
twoStarDescription: Sort at least four, and set aside one you will not force.
threeStarDescription: Point to a scale-like leaf or say you did not find one.

title: Note which way a shell coils
description: Hold a spiral shell and say whether the opening is on the left or the right when the tip is up.
oneStarDescription: Hold the tip upward. A second person can see that this step happened: set the tip up.
twoStarDescription: Say which side the opening is on.
threeStarDescription: Do a second shell, or say you have only one.

title: Note the time of the first bird
description: Write the time you first hear a bird on a morning you chose, and do not name the species.
oneStarDescription: Write that you will listen.
twoStarDescription: Write the time of the first sound you take to be a bird.
threeStarDescription: Write that the species is not named.

title: Tell odd and even street numbers
description: Walk or read a short row of house numbers and say which side is odd.
oneStarDescription: Read two numbers on one side.
twoStarDescription: Say whether they rise by twos or by ones.
threeStarDescription: Point to the side with odd numbers, or say the row is not enough.

title: Place a subject on a third
description: Take a photo with the subject near a third of the frame, not dead center, and say which third.
oneStarDescription: Say left or right before you shoot.
twoStarDescription: Take the photo with the subject near that third.
threeStarDescription: Look at the photo and say whether the subject stayed near that third.

title: Finish a dots-and-boxes square
description: Play a small dots-and-boxes grid until you close one square on purpose.
oneStarDescription: Draw a small grid of dots.
twoStarDescription: Draw lines until a square can be closed.
threeStarDescription: Close a square and mark it as yours.

title: Play one hopscotch turn
description: Hop a short hopscotch court you drew, pick up the marker, and come back.
oneStarDescription: Draw a small court on safe ground.
twoStarDescription: Hop to the marker and pick it up.
threeStarDescription: Hop back without stepping on a line you meant to avoid, or say where you stepped.

title: Tell a plucked note from a bowed one
description: Hear two string sounds and say which was plucked and which was bowed.
oneStarDescription: Listen to both before you answer.
twoStarDescription: Say which is plucked and which is bowed.
threeStarDescription: If one is unclear, say so.

title: Point to the louder of two sounds
description: Hear two sounds and point to the louder one, then say if they were close.
oneStarDescription: Listen once. A second person can see that this step happened: hear both.
twoStarDescription: Point to the louder source or the louder moment.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the difference was clear or close.

title: Pot on a seedling
description: Move a seedling into a larger pot and water it so the soil settles.
oneStarDescription: Put soil in the new pot.
twoStarDescription: Lift the seedling with soil around the roots and set it in.
threeStarDescription: Water it and show the stem is upright.

title: Print a leaf
description: Ink or paint the back of a leaf and print it once on paper.
oneStarDescription: Put a thin layer of paint on the leaf.
twoStarDescription: Press it on paper and lift it.
threeStarDescription: Point to a vein that came through, or say the print is only a blot.

title: Tell a raw edge from a hemmed edge
description: Point to a raw edge and a hemmed edge on cloth you may handle.
oneStarDescription: Point to an edge that can fray.
twoStarDescription: Point to a folded finished edge.
threeStarDescription: Say which edge still needs a finish.

title: Read a battery size
description: Read the size on a battery and match it to a slot that shows the same size, without forcing it.
oneStarDescription: Read the size code. A second person can see that this step happened: read the size.
twoStarDescription: Point to a slot marked with that size, or say you have no matching slot.
threeStarDescription: If it does not drop in, stop. Do not bend a contact.

title: Read a bus headsign
description: Read the destination on a bus or a photo of a headsign and say what it does not tell you.
oneStarDescription: Say the place name you can read.
twoStarDescription: Point to the number, or say there is none.
threeStarDescription: Say one thing the sign does not tell you, such as the next stop.

title: Read a dynamic mark
description: Point to p or f in a score and say quieter or louder, without playing the piece.
oneStarDescription: Point to p or f. A second person can see that this step happened: find the mark.
twoStarDescription: Say quieter or louder. A second person can see that this step happened: say the meaning.
threeStarDescription: Find the other mark, or say the page has only one.

title: Read a fiber on a care label
description: Read one fiber from a care label and say one thing the label does not tell you.
oneStarDescription: Point to the fiber line, not the wash tub only.
twoStarDescription: Read the fiber name or the percentage you can see.
threeStarDescription: Say one care step the label does not answer.

title: Read a fuse number and stop
description: Read the number printed on a fuse or a fuse photo, and do not put the fuse into anything.
oneStarDescription: Read the amp number or say it is worn off.
twoStarDescription: Say you are not choosing a replacement by guess.
threeStarDescription: Leave the fuse where it was.

title: Read a garden label
description: Read the plant name on a garden label and one growing note, and say if the name is worn off.
oneStarDescription: Point to the label for one plant.
twoStarDescription: Read the name, or say it is unreadable.
threeStarDescription: Read sun, water, or height if it is there, or say it is not.

title: Read a grainline arrow
description: On a pattern piece, point to the grainline arrow and lay it along the cloth length.
oneStarDescription: Point to the grainline arrow.
twoStarDescription: Point along the cloth, using the selvage if there is one.
threeStarDescription: Lay the arrow along that length, or say the piece is too big for the scrap.

title: Find a house number between two others
description: Given two house numbers, point to where a missing number would fall.
oneStarDescription: Read the two numbers you can see.
twoStarDescription: Point to the stretch between them.
threeStarDescription: Say which number should fall there, or that the numbering skips.

title: Read a menu price
description: Read one item and its price, and say whether a tax or a tip is included if the menu says.
oneStarDescription: Say the item name. A second person can see that this step happened: read the item.
twoStarDescription: Say the price next to it.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the menu says tax or tip is extra, or that it does not say.

title: Read a platform clock against a timetable
description: Read a station clock and a listed departure and say whether you are early or late for that listing.
oneStarDescription: Read the time. A second person can see that this step happened: read the clock.
twoStarDescription: Read one departure time.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the clock is before or after that listing.

title: Read a rain gauge you set out
description: Set a gauge or a straight-sided cup, read the depth, and empty it.
oneStarDescription: Put it in the open, not under a roof.
twoStarDescription: Read the water line and write the number with the date.
threeStarDescription: Empty it and show the zero line.
